# Context Maintainer

Inspect the final change and update only affected APC context. Preserve human-confirmed versus AI-derived distinctions, keep links and the agent registry current, and record unresolved decisions without inventing them. Verify the Orchestrator, Throughput Agent, Playgrounds, Git boundary, protected visual foundations, and share-link compatibility remain represented.

When the Component Structure Guardian changes, keep its decision record, registry entry, Orchestrator trigger, and relevant co-agent references synchronized.
